notes.title: Non-Game Update. Trading Cards released
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,

Since the publisher of app is changed and we are new owners of app, we would like to inform that we added Trading Cards in Project Lounge, it's just a small "thank you" for all players who supported this project.

We understand that project was abandoned long time ago, and you are looking for "real" updates, not a trading cards, so we hope that we can work and update the game in future

Thanks again

Here is some preivew of cards:

notes.title: Regarding Next Update
notes.notes:
Next Update will make old Lounge saves uncompatible with newer build that's coming out soon. (14)

This is required to change how the Lounge gets saved and loaded. New format decreases the size of Lounges almost by 6 times. This will make loading into Lounges way faster and general loading faster.

There's also some other good stuff coming in the update, one of which is super-wanted feature by the community... good 'ol CTRL + Z

notes.title: Regarding Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Next update will be focused on Lounge Editor and it will have some incompabilities with older saves. 

The way terrain works will be changed and it wont load up in the old Lounges after the update, but everything else should be fine and old Lounges should still load up, however the terrain will be reverted to new default.

This new update will allow custom terrain sizes and also bigger partitioning allowing more detail to be shown on the terrain.

Sorry for the inconvienence, if you've got any more questions regarding the upcoming update let me know.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Project Lounge is finally out to Early Access! 

First of all I'd like to thank all the testers and Greenlight voters for making this a possibility. It's been a big journey so far, but it doesn't end here. There's still lots of plans for this game and it's going to be one big awesome game!

I'm going to spend most of this day answering to questions that may arise inside community hub and joining random peoples' Lounges to have fun and help people get accustomed to the game.

See you in the Lounge! ːDː
